Check your Binance referral code in India

Use this guide to check whether your Binance referral URL includes a code before signup, then confirm the final status directly inside Binance after login.

Check a referral linkCheck inside Binance

Privacy-first checker

No password, OTP, UID, API key, email verification code, or identity document is needed to check whether a link contains a referral parameter.

Recommended steps

Paste your Binance link into the link checker and confirm that it uses an official Binance domain.
Look for the referral code parameter in the URL, for example ref=MAXUP.
Log in to Binance and open the official referral activity page. Referral details may appear in the lower section of the page.

Official Binance confirmation

Country rules and product availability can change. Use Binance's logged-in screen for final referral, fee discount, and account eligibility confirmation.

Open official referral page
Independent referral diagnosis page. Always confirm final account status through Binance.
